column1: "title": "Intel Stock Surges to 4-Year High Ahead of Earnings. Why Optimism Is Growing."
"summary": "Intel's stock has surged to a four-year high
column2: having more than doubled in the past year
column3: as the company approaches its latest earnings report. Analysts are showing increasing optimism about Intel's future prospects. This positive sentiment is contributing to the stock's continued strong performance."

column1: "title": "Gene Munster Mostly Agrees With Leading Apple Analyst About Road Ahead For Apple In Next 8 Months: 'You Can Take This To The Bank'"
"summary": "Gene Munster of Deepwater Asset Management largely agrees with Bloomberg's Mark Gurman regarding Apple's potential stock boost in the next eight months
column2: citing two upcoming Siri updates as key catalysts. The first update
column4: will enhance web search and on-screen content analysis
column5: while a more significant update in iOS 27 and macOS 27 will transform Siri into a full chatbot
column6: positioning Apple more competitively in the AI market. This development comes as Apple has lagged behind rivals like Amazon
column8: and Microsoft in AI investment and recently partnered with Google for its AI features."
